About Birjhora Mahavidyalaya
The Science Campus
Established in 1986 as Birjhora Science College, we are a premier co-educational institution in Bongaigaon, Assam. Recognised by the UGC and newly upgraded as the dedicated Science Campus (
Constituent College
) of Bongaigaon University, we offer quality science education spanning the Four Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP – NEP 2020) and advanced Postgraduate (M.Sc.) degrees.
Our recent NAAC accreditation with a
CGPA of 2.90 (B++)
in the third cycle, combined with our historic March 2026 upgrade to become the first Constituent College of entire Assam and potential Science Campus of Bongaigaon University, reflects our unyielding commitment to continuous improvement and world-class quality education.
